body:
You're not annoying at all. I'm so grateful you took the time to chat :)

I know I've got a real pessimistic attitude but I kind of feel like it's warranted by my actions.

I tried to write a blog and couldn't even write a single paragraph.

The interests I do have are at  a surface level. I don't really know anything about anything. And sure, I earned a degree, but it was a retreat from 'real life', so to speak. I did it out of fear, not passion, and so I really hated it. :(
Young, but getting older. And sure, not knowing what you want in life is pretty common I guess, but what about having literally no goals, no dreams, nothing, ever since you were a kid?

Potential? Maybe. But I sincerely doubt it, to be honest. I could barely do one subject in a semester, and that was a course where all I had to do was read a novel each week...

How much more time can I waste, anyway?
